Z8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
ChIP is crosslinked proximity in a population. A factor tethered indirectly at an
element looks identical to one that binds it, and the overlap block cannot tell a
shared direct contact from two independent tetherings.
191 of 723 factor names have a K562 track and ENCODE's roster is enriched for the
factors people study, so the overlap is computed over a biased slice of the proteome.
The dinucleotide shuffle that gated every sequence loop has no meaning here --
shuffling DNA does not move a peak call -- so Z5's permutation is the control that
carries the weight, and it tests only the gene axis.
Accessibility, crowding and validated-enhancer status are all properties of the same
4,482 elements the screens pre-selected for looking regulatory.
